definition.name: operator-algebra-theta-framing
definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex (tex:1054, inside the compression-map definition): the symmetric combination (1/2)(L_P R_Q + R_Q L_P) 'is an O(delta+eps)-idempotent element of the algebra of operators acting on A, and therefore, can be approximated by an idempotent using Proposition prop_P'. I.e. the theta calculus is applied inside the Banach algebra of bounded operators on A (a unital associative Banach algebra), where the compression operator lives.
